Title: NL, CL, and the "Sensible?" rules for VTES.

Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question can anyone put me on the right track to
finding some articles on these "sensible players rules", and some of the
standard formats and conventions of CL games? (I'm assuming that NL by
nature has no additional rules.)
Thanks Karl

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


The sensible player tournament rules have, for the most part, been
replaced by the DCI official tournament rules. I would suggest using
the official rules.

SPTR are available at:
http://mrfrench.cslab.uwlax.edu:80/~sulli_al/jyhad/SPTR.html

DCI rules are available at:
http://www.wizards.com/DCI/VTES_Rules.html

CL games typically have no official formats other than "4CL" or, sometimes,
"4CL with no more than 1 of any unique card". Often CL environments are
modified by the unwritten "no Malk S&B decks" rule.

NL has no additional rules, provided that you use either the official DCI
rules, or implement you own verion of the SPTR rules.
